primary_protocol_sources.fact: The ldr:ro wrapper sends command4, an eight-byte zero ClientProcessId placeholder, the PID descriptor and one input current-process handle. Other commands load/unload NRO/NRR and are outside this implementation
The service object owns a process context. RegisterProcessHandle accepts ClientProcessId and COPY process handle; its destructor unregisters its context

Registration validates process-handle identity against authenticated client PID, rejects an already registered process as InvalidSession, and retains the server-owned handle/context until finalization. This host adapts only the single native current-process identity
RO module22 and InvalidSession description1030 produce result0x80c16 for duplicate registration

implemented_contract.endpoint: ldr:ro only; no unobserved ro:1 or ro:dmnt capability registration
implemented_contract.command4: Validate CMIF request4/6, PID descriptor, one COPY current-process pseudo handle, no moved handles or buffers, raw u64zero with only CMIF alignment slack. Persist a genuine per-object native-process registration and return an empty response
implemented_contract.identity_boundary: The in-process IPC core does not perform Horizon kernel PID injection; raw rq.pid bits are not trusted. Only the measured current-process pseudo handle is accepted, and registration binds the service's actual getpid() identity. No foreign process, claimed Horizon numeric PID or OS process-handle duplication is fabricated; the caller pseudo handle is never consumed or closed
implemented_contract.duplicate_registration: A repeated command4 on the same shared object, or an independent object while this process is already registered, returns the primary InvalidSession0x80c16 without replacing the existing registration
implemented_contract.lifetime: Each open allocates one state with reference count1. Opt-in generic retained sessions call retain for independent clones/copies, transfer ownership on domain conversion, and release on close. Last service-state release unregisters the process and frees state, including domain root-object close while an empty transport remains open
implemented_contract.concurrency: A mutex protects reference counts and the single native-process registration owner. An unregistered object's close cannot remove another object's registration
implemented_contract.unsupported: All service commands other than4, including MapNro0, UnmapNro1, RegisterModuleInfo2, UnregisterModuleInfo3 and RegisterModuleInfoWithUserProcessHandle10, stop through ipc_unimplemented. No NRR authorization, mapping, signature validation, loader permission, asset load, game entry or SDK-init override is represented by registration success
implemented_contract.guard: Constructor only registers the service/ownership callbacks. Open and every service request require the existing compile-time diagnostic opt-in and checked private host run. No profile, environment, file, log, handle or process lookup occurs in this module before main

native_validation.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_ro_ipc.py -v
native_validation.uses: The actual runtime/ipc.c HIPC parser, CMIF/domain/control dispatch and session ownership, actual threads.c handle CloseHandle, actual ro_host.c; original tiny native request fixtures, no game or SDK code
positive_cases: Registration-only constructor in default and diagnostic builds creates no state, handles or files
SM returns an actual moved retained service; valid type4/type6 command4 persists actual host PID with empty output, including when wire PID bits differ
Same-object repeat and same-process independent registration return the exact primary InvalidSession; final close permits a later real registration
Non-domain clone before/after registration, domain clone/CloneEx, CopyFromDomain, domain-root close and entire-domain destruction retain state until its last actual owner closes
Closing an unregistered state cannot affect another registration; last domain-object release unregisters before transport close
1000 real open/register/domain/clone/copy/close cycles leave zero RO objects, zero tracked IPC allocations, no registration owner and no remaining handle slots
negative_cases: Missing PID/COPY, extra COPY, MOVE handle, unknown/thread/session process handle, nonzero ClientProcessId placeholder
Every X/A/B/W/C buffer family, unmeasured TIPC, truncated or oversized domain raw arguments
Unknown control and all unimplemented service/load/map/NRR commands stop explicitly
Missing checked run or compile-time diagnostic opt-in prevents service open; adapters create no extra files
